THE SEVENTH BINDING CARRIES A PRECONDITION RATHER THAN A MAPPING [claim G49-22]. The same frame is bound to Sinai - three classes the three flocks, the commandments the water, the stone the Presence - and the condition is stated as law: had even ONE been missing, the Torah would not have been received. An all-or-nothing gate on the whole system. [folded shape: priced law]

A TRAVEL DIALOGUE IS CONVERTED INTO A SCHEDULE [claim G49-27]. Coming 'from Haran' is read as fleeing wrath; the man's name is read as the one destined to WHITEN your iniquities; and the report that he is well, with his daughter approaching, is answered from the prophet in which that same daughter weeps for her children and is told there is hope for your future.
